name: dsh-spotlight
title_zh: 键盘流命令面板，让 DeepSeek Harness
tagline_zh: 鼠标点三层的操作，现在一个快捷键直达。为重度键盘用户设计，连翻页、切模型、看历史都无需离开键盘。
tagline_en: Three layers of mouse clicks, now one hotkey away. Built for keyboard zealots—paging, model switching.
desc_en: Keyboard-first command palette for DeepSeek Harness Web
why_zh: 不是套壳搜索框，而是深度绑定 Harness 内部状态机。每个命令都直连数据层，响应零延迟。
why_en: Not a wrapped search box—it's wired into Harness's internal state machine. Every command hits the data layer directly.
limit_zh: 仅适用于 DeepSeek Harness 网页版，且需浏览器支持 WebSocket。不覆盖移动端触屏操作。
limit_en: Only for DeepSeek Harness web UI; requires WebSocket-capable browser. No touch-screen support; collapses to plain search on narrow viewports.
